reviewBasis: Dev-context steering: 'No heavy ceremony for data protection. Self-review is acceptable for pre-production gate closure.'
scopeReviewed: 3.9.1 Runtime-serializable v2 envelopes, DTOs, capabilities, warnings/degradation, errors, operation limits
3.9.2 search, neighborhood, path, trace.get, aggregate, predict, temporal.diff, patch.list, lazy inspect endpoints
3.9.3 command.preview/commit/undo, lifecycle, source, goal, health/capabilities, interchange, export/import/rebuild jobs
3.9.4 WAL snapshot cursors with authenticated policy/revision/sort/expiry
3.9.5 Base→target bounded patches, invalidation/recovery cursor, 10k revisions / 7 days retention
3.9.6 Tauri event/command and Axum HTTP/SSE thin adapters

findings.description: Legacy memory/graph/search/full-refresh APIs and adapter business logic still coexist with v2 surface. No production users exist; hard cutover acceptable pre-production.
findings.disposition: Documented as NBW-F3-04. Full cutover and legacy deletion deferred to F5 per execution contract.

verdictRationale: All canonical API v2 sub-tasks (3.9.1–3.9.7) implemented. v2 envelopes carry policy-safe opaque exclusion tokens; unknown-field/version behavior defined; cursor expiry and refetch semantics specified; adapters are thin wrappers with explicit capability differences for local-only operations. Legacy coexistence acceptable pre-production with 0 external consumers.
plannedFollowUp: Legacy API cutover and deletion at F5 (NBW-F3-04)
